whatThisIs: Check an X12 837 professional or institutional claim file before submission. The checker validates envelope controls, identifier formats, diagnosis-code structure, date logic and each claim's line-charge total.
whenToUse: Use this after generating a claim file and before sending it to a payer or clearinghouse. It finds structural and arithmetic defects locally without applying payer edits or X12 situational rules.
inputs: One or more X12 837P 005010X222A1 or 837I 005010X223A2 text files, up to 50 MB each. Files remain in the browser tab.
output: A clean-or-failing count, a claim table with every finding and segment position, and full or redacted CSV downloads. Redacted downloads mask patient names, member IDs and claim references.

rows: Charge equals line total; identifiers and dates pass
Charge mismatch, invalid NPI and invalid diagnosis structure
example.result: 1 of 2 claims passed all checks; 1 failed with 3 findings.
